mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of professional drywall finishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence the cost of professional drywall finishing. These include the total square footage of the walls and ceilings, the desired level of finish (e.g., Level 3 versus Level 5), and the current condition of the drywall. Complex architectural features like arches, vaulted ceilings, or numerous corners will increase labor time and material usage, leading to higher costs. Accessibility of the work area and any necessary repairs to existing drywall before finishing also play a role in the overall pricing. Location can also have a minor impact on labor rates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for drywall finishing depend on square footage, finish level, wall complexity (e.g., arches), and existing drywall condition. More detailed work or repairs will increase the price.
